dialogues.jp:
玄関に向かう学生を｛うらや／羨｝みながら、階段を上った
り下がったりと、学園を｛はいかい／徘徊｝する。
dialogues.en:
She liked my idea, but I found out that she asked the same
question to another boy in her class. He gave her a comic
book as a reference......
dialogues.text:
She liked my idea, but I found out that she asked the same
question to another boy in her class. He gave her a comic
book as a reference......

dialogues.jp: 何か面白いことがあるかと思ったのだが……。
dialogues.en: 'Big fat chairman'.
dialogues.text: 'Big fat chairman'.

dialogues.en:
I went up and down the stairs and wandered around the school
as I saw multiple students walking toward the exit.
dialogues.text:
I went up and down the stairs and wandered around the school
as I saw multiple students walking toward the exit.

dialogues.jp: 「アホくさ……帰ろう……」
dialogues.en: I was hoping I'd encounter something interesting......
dialogues.text: I was hoping I'd encounter something interesting......

dialogues.jp:
学生の流れにのって、俺も玄関に足を向ける。
まずは付属の校舎に行かないと……。

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "It's boring...... I'm going home......"
dialogues.text: "It's boring...... I'm going home......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "Hello, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Hello, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
珍しいところで出会ったな――って、俺が本校
を徘徊しているのが珍しいんだった。
dialogues.en: "Oh, hello."
dialogues.text: "Oh, hello."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「今からお帰りですか？」
dialogues.en:
I don't usually see her in this building...... well, I don't
usually hang out in the main building anyway.
dialogues.text:
I don't usually see her in this building...... well, I don't
usually hang out in the main building anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ええ」
dialogues.en: "Are you going back home?"
dialogues.text: "Are you going back home?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの……では一緒に帰ってもよろしいでしょ
　うか？　ちょっとお聞きしたいことがあるん
　ですけど」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「聞きたいこと？　えと、まぁ、とりあえず歩
　きながら」
dialogues.en:
"Umm...... May I join you, if you don't mind? I have
something I want to ask you."
dialogues.text:
"Umm...... May I join you, if you don't mind? I have
something I want to ask you."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず、玄関が別々なので一度別れてから、
落ち合うことにする。
dialogues.en:
We had to go out different ways, so we decided to meet
later.
dialogues.text:
We had to go out different ways, so we decided to meet
later.

dialogues.jp: 「それで｛き／訊｝きたいことって？」
dialogues.en: "So, what is it that you want to ask me?"
dialogues.text: "So, what is it that you want to ask me?"

dialogues.jp:
校門の前で萌先輩と落ち合い、桜並木に向かっ
て歩きだす。
dialogues.en:
I met Moe-sempai at the gate and started to walk toward the
avenue of cherry blossoms.
dialogues.text:
I met Moe-sempai at the gate and started to walk toward the
avenue of cherry blossoms.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「それが、昨日弟に質問されたんですけど、私
　うまく答えることが出来なくて」
dialogues.en:
"Well, my brother asked me something yesterday, but I didn't
know how to answer him."
dialogues.text:
"Well, my brother asked me something yesterday, but I didn't
know how to answer him."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「はは。年下の子の質問に答えられないっての
　は確かに面目がたたないですもんね。それで
　何を訊かれたんです？」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha. It does feel awkward not being able to answer a
question asked by someone younger than you. So what did he
ask?"
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha. It does feel awkward not being able to answer a
question asked by someone younger than you. So what did he
ask?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「子供のつくりかたです」
dialogues.en: "He asked me how babies are made."
dialogues.text: "He asked me how babies are made."

dialogues.jp: ――医学問題？
dialogues.en: ......That's a medical question!
dialogues.text: ......That's a medical question!

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「私じゃよく説明できなくて」
dialogues.en: "I couldn't explain it to him very well......"
dialogues.text: "I couldn't explain it to him very well......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「このぐらいの歳の子って、そういうことに疑
　問をもつものなんでしょうか？」
dialogues.en:
"Do kids around his age already have an interest in things
like that?"
dialogues.text:
"Do kids around his age already have an interest in things
like that?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いや……どうかな」
dialogues.en: "Well...... I don't know."
dialogues.text: "Well...... I don't know."

dialogues.jp: そもそも、先輩の弟さんの歳を俺は知らないし。
dialogues.en: I don't know how old her brother is in the first place.
dialogues.text: I don't know how old her brother is in the first place.

dialogues.jp:
そう言えば、俺も太古の昔、両親に同じことを
訊いたことがあったような。
dialogues.en:
I can recall asking the same question to my parents a long
time ago.
dialogues.text:
I can recall asking the same question to my parents a long
time ago.

dialogues.jp:
そのときの親の気持ちが、ちょっと分かった気
がする……。
dialogues.en: I understand their feelings now......
dialogues.text: I understand their feelings now......

dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、めしべとおしべの関係と説明するの
　はどうかな」
dialogues.en: "How about explaining the pistil and stamen of flowers?"
dialogues.text: "How about explaining the pistil and stamen of flowers?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「めしべと……おしべですか？」
dialogues.en: "Pistil...... and stamen?"
dialogues.text: "Pistil...... and stamen?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そう」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「おしべの花粉がめしべに運ばれて、受粉して
　種ができることに例えるんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"The pollen on the stamen gets transferred to the pistil,
and the seed's developed, right?"
dialogues.text:
"The pollen on the stamen gets transferred to the pistil,
and the seed's developed, right?"

dialogues.jp:
わが身に刻み込まれた、両親の説明をそのまま
伝授する。
dialogues.en: I told her the same explanation I got from my parents.
dialogues.text: I told her the same explanation I got from my parents.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「めしべと、おしべ……」
dialogues.en: "Pistil, and stamen......"
dialogues.text: "Pistil, and stamen......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いいですね」
dialogues.en: "That sounds good."
dialogues.text: "That sounds good."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうですか？」
dialogues.en: "You think so?"
dialogues.text: "You think so?"

dialogues.jp:
本当にいいかどうかは分からないが、まぁ、喜
んでもらえたなら問題なし。
dialogues.en: I don't know if it's really good, but at least she liked it.
dialogues.text: I don't know if it's really good, but at least she liked it.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くんに訊いて、よかったです」
dialogues.en: "I'm glad I asked you, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "I'm glad I asked you, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
いやー、はははと頭を｛か／掻｝いているところに、眞
子がやってきた。
dialogues.en: "It's not a big deal."
dialogues.text: "It's not a big deal."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、眞子ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "I guess I don't need this anymore."
dialogues.text: "I guess I don't need this anymore."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩が嬉しそうに、にこにことさっきまでの
経緯を説明した。
dialogues.en:
She opened her bag and took out the paper bag from the book
store.
dialogues.text:
She opened her bag and took out the paper bag from the book
store.

dialogues.jp: 眞子が呆れたように、眉をひそめる。
dialogues.en: Just by looking at the size......
dialogues.text: Just by looking at the size......

dialogues.jp:
話から察するに、どうやら眞子も似たような質
問をされたらしい。
dialogues.en: "Is that a comic book?"
dialogues.text: "Is that a comic book?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「はい。でも、今、朝倉くんから、いい説明を
　教えてもらったので助かりました」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. A boy in my class gave this to me. He said that I can
use this as a reference."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. A boy in my class gave this to me. He said that I can
use this as a reference."

dialogues.jp: 言って、萌先輩が俺のほうを見て微笑みかける。
dialogues.en:
"What? What kind of comic book can be used as a reference in
teaching how babies are made?"
dialogues.text:
"What? What kind of comic book can be used as a reference in
teaching how babies are made?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ねっ、朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Umm, I'm not sure. I haven't opened it yet."
dialogues.text: "Umm, I'm not sure. I haven't opened it yet."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ええ、まあ……」
dialogues.en: "Let's take a look now."
dialogues.text: "Let's take a look now."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あんた……変なこと言ってないでしょうね？」
dialogues.en: She broke the tape on the bag and opened it up.
dialogues.text: She broke the tape on the bag and opened it up.

dialogues.jp: 眞子は｛いぶか／訝｝しげな視線を投げかけてくる。
「失礼なやつだな……。正直言って自信作だぞ」
dialogues.en:
Through Moe's fingers, I saw a picture of a girl with a big
stomach...... Her face was full of fear.
dialogues.text:
Through Moe's fingers, I saw a picture of a girl with a big
stomach...... Her face was full of fear.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「どうだか……。お姉ちゃんに変なこと吹き込
　むのだけはやめてよね」
dialogues.en: The title of the book is......
dialogues.text: The title of the book is......

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「そんなこと言うんだったらお前が答えてやれ
　ばよかっただろう？」
dialogues.en: 'Big fat chairman'.
dialogues.text: 'Big fat chairman'.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そ、それは……」
眞子は赤くなって口｛こも／篭｝る。
dialogues.en: Who the heck gave this book to her?
dialogues.text: Who the heck gave this book to her?

dialogues.jp: ほらみろ。少しは感謝して欲しいものだ。
dialogues.en: "I'll take care of that book......"
dialogues.text: "I'll take care of that book......"

dialogues.jp:
……なんて言っても、どうせ何か言い返される
だけだから言わないけどな。
dialogues.en:
I put the book inside of the paper bag and put it into my
bag.
dialogues.text:
I put the book inside of the paper bag and put it into my
bag.

dialogues.jp: ……やれやれ。
dialogues.en: I'll get rid of it...... after I read it once.
dialogues.text: I'll get rid of it...... after I read it once.

dialogues.jp: ◆めしべとおしべ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Big fat chairman◆
dialogues.text: ◆Big fat chairman◆

dialogues.jp:
何やら俺に話があるという萌先輩と、校門の所
で待ち合わせをした。
dialogues.en:
I met Moe-sempai at the gate, because she wanted to ask me
something.
dialogues.text:
I met Moe-sempai at the gate, because she wanted to ask me
something.

dialogues.jp:
何でも、弟さんから赤ちゃんの作り方を｛き／訊｝かれ
てしまったらしい。俺は、“めしべとおしべ”
で説明したらどうかと言った。
dialogues.en:
She told me that her brother asked how babies are made. I
suggested she explain the reproduction process of flowers,
the 'Pistil and Stamen'.
dialogues.text:
She told me that her brother asked how babies are made. I
suggested she explain the reproduction process of flowers,
the 'Pistil and Stamen'.
